## Checklist

- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes
- [ ] `go test -race ./...` passes
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] New keybindings are documented in the status bar, `yad --help`, and **both** READMEs
- [ ] Cursor-based actions use `currentEntry()`, never `m.entries[m.cursor]`
